0022600185.text: The Los Angeles Lakers (6-2, 1st in the Pacific, 4th in the West) head into this 9th game of their season on a two-game winning streak, and they are 2-1 on the road. They face a Sacramento Kings team that is 1-6 and 15th in the West, 4.5 games behind in the Pacific, and 0-2 at home. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Lakers won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 128-104 win in Los Angeles on March 1, 2026. Lakers forward Adou Thiero is out with knee inflammation, while the Kings are without Ben Simmons (Achilles surgery), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Precious Achiuwa is a game-time decision with ankle soreness.
